### Describe the Issue

After activating a waystone the game will not save, gamemode switching wont work, blocks will break but not drop anything, any progress after activating the waystone will not save.
i can quit my world,but it will keep (trying to) save ,but it never saves.
Maybe there is more,but i haven`t tried many more things.
I am on the newest version of balm,waystones and fabric on modrinth 8.0.0.2
I am using a couple other mods, but they worked just fine with waystones when i tried.
Edit: i can also not interact with tile entities or normal mobs

Please provide the **full** logs. You can find the logs in the `logs` directory of the client or server. Most of the time `latest.log` is the correct file (unless the crash or issue happened during an earlier run).

Logs can be uploaded here by dragging the file into the comment field, or you can post them on a site like https://gist.github.com/ or https://pastebin.com/. Make sure they are set to be `public` (or unlisted) and to `never expire`.
